name: devtwin
description: DevTwin - AI-Powered Codebase Digital Twin MVP

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install

author: DevTwin Team
